column1: In this connection, Mr. S R Attygalle, Secretary to the Ministry of Finance on behalf of the Government of
Sri Lanka and Mr. Chen Chen, Country Director of ADB Sri Lanka Resident Mission on behalf of ADB,
signed the Loan Agreement to obtain USD 400 million on 1st December 2020 at the Ministry of Finance.
This Press Release is issued by the Department of External Resources on 1st  December 2020.
